2607.04733.title: LP-SFT: Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Multimodal Entropy Structure
2607.04733.paper_summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting pretrained language models to downstream domains, yet it often improves target-domain behavior at the cost of degrading pre-existing capabilities. Standard cross-entropy fine-tuning promotes only the observed label token and leaves unconstrained how probability mass is redistributed over other plausible alternatives, potentially distorting the rich local preference structure learned during pretraining. We first analyze next-token predictions using Shannon and Renyi entropies, revealing that pretrained models exhibit a regular multimodal entropy structure. These entropy peaks correspond to varying numbers of plausible alternatives, indicating that the base model intrinsically encodes rich distributional knowledge beyond the single supervised token. Motivated by this observation, we propose LP-SFT, a Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning objective designed to explicitly protect this inherent entropy structure. At each step, LP-SFT constructs an adaptive support of alternative tokens and applies a locally normalized preservation loss to maintain the base model's relative structure among them, while standard cross-entropy independently optimizes the supervised token. Across mixed-domain and single-domain fine-tuning experiments, LP-SFT improves overall performance over vanilla SFT and recent SFT-enhancement baselines, achieving the best balance between pass@1 accuracy and pass@k performance. These results suggest that local preservation helps mitigate capability degradation without collapsing sampling-accessible diversity.
2607.04733.paper_summary_zh: 監督微調（SFT）是將預訓練語言模型適應於下游領域的標準方法，但這通常會以降低先前能力為代價來改善目標領域的行為。標準的交叉熵微調僅促進觀察到的標籤標記，並且對其他合理替代方案的概率質量重新分配不加限制，這可能會扭曲在預訓練期間學到的豐富局部偏好結構。我們首先使用香農和雷尼熵分析下一個標記的預測，揭示預訓練模型展示出規律的多模態熵結構。這些熵峰對應於不同數量的合理替代方案，表明基礎模型內在地編碼了超越單一監督標記的豐富分佈知識。基於這一觀察，我們提出了LP-SFT，一種局部保護監督微調目標，旨在明確保護這一固有的熵結構。在每一步中，LP-SFT構建了一個替代標記的自適應支持，並應用局部正規化保護損失，以維持基礎模型在它們之間的相對結構，而標準的交叉熵則獨立地優化監督標記。在混合領域和單一領域的微調實驗中，LP-SFT在整體性能上優於普通SFT和最近的SFT增強基準，實現了pass@1準確率和pass@k性能之間的最佳平衡。這些結果表明，局部保護有助於減輕能力退化，而不會崩潰可採樣的多樣性。
